content.faq.title: FAQ & beginner's guide
content.faq.description: Everything you need to get started: requirements, how a race day works, signing off, lag and disconnects, setup tips and the most common questions.
content.faq.lead: New to the league? Here is everything you need to know before your first race – plus answers to the questions we are asked most often.
content.faq.requirements.title: Requirements
content.faq.requirements.lead: What you need to race with us.
content.faq.raceday.title: How a race day works
content.faq.raceday.lead: T is the start time shown in the calendar. Deadlines may differ slightly per season – the rulebook and the race page are what count.
content.faq.signoff.title: Signing off via Discord
content.faq.signoff.lead: Can't make a race? No problem – just let us know in good time so a reserve driver can step in.
content.faq.signoff.step1: Open the sign-off channel on our Discord server.
content.faq.signoff.step2: Post a short message saying which race you are signing off from. You don't have to give a reason.
content.faq.signoff.step3: Deadline: no later than 24 hours before the start. After that, your sign-off counts as late – but it is still much better than none at all.
content.faq.signoff.step4: An unexcused absence earns a warning the first time. If it happens again, you may be moved to the reserve pool.
content.faq.signoff.rules: Rulebook §2.5 – Signing off from a race
content.faq.lag.title: Lag & disconnects
content.faq.lag.lead: Online races run over the internet – and sometimes things go wrong. Here is how to deal with it.
content.faq.setup.title: Setup tips for getting started
content.faq.setup.lead: No secret recipes, just solid basics that help you drive cleanly and consistently.
content.faq.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
content.faq.empty: The most common questions will appear here soon.
content.faq.more.title: Still got questions?
content.faq.more.text: Just ask on Discord or write to us using the contact form. When you're ready: signing up only takes a few minutes.
content.about.title: About us
content.about.description: The people behind the league: the organising team, our values and the roles we are looking to fill.
content.about.lead: The league is run by people who love racing themselves – as volunteers, in their spare time.
content.about.intro.title: Who we are
content.about.intro.text1: We are an independent community league for EA SPORTS F1® 25. PC, PlayStation and Xbox players race together on one grid with 22 regular cockpits and a reserve pool.
content.about.intro.text2: Fair racing, transparent decisions and a friendly atmosphere matter to us. That is why all results, standings and steward decisions are public and easy to follow – from the very first race.
content.about.values.fair.title: Fair
content.about.values.fair.text: Clear rules, a four-eyes principle for the stewards and reasoning you can follow.
content.about.values.open.title: Open
content.about.values.open.text: Crossplay on every platform, with wheel and controller treated equally.
content.about.values.reliable.title: Reliable
content.about.values.reliable.text: Fixed race dates, quick results and an archive that stays.
content.about.team.title: Organising team
content.about.team.lead: These people look after the season, race control, the stewards and our content.
content.about.team.empty: The organising team will introduce itself here soon.
content.about.positions.title: Join the team
content.about.positions.lead: Want to do more than race? These roles are currently open – experience is nice, reliability matters more.
content.about.positions.contact.title: How to apply
content.about.positions.contact.text: Open a ticket on our Discord server and mention the role you are interested in. Tell us briefly what you would bring – we will get back to you.
content.about.positions.empty.title: No roles are open right now
content.about.positions.empty.text: Got an idea anyway or want to help out? Just drop us a line.
content.partners.title: Partners
content.partners.description: The league's partners and sponsors – clearly labelled as advertising. And how you can become a partner yourself.
content.partners.lead: Partners help us pay for prizes, tech and streams. Every partnership is labelled as advertising.
content.partners.empty.title: No partners yet
content.partners.empty.text: Would you like to support the league? Read on to find out how.
content.partners.independence: Partners have no influence on line-ups, results, steward decisions or news.
content.partners.become.title: Become a partner
content.partners.become.text: Want to reach an active sim racing community on PC, PlayStation and Xbox? We offer space on the website, in streams and on social media – honestly labelled and a good fit for our community.
content.partners.exclusions.title: Who we don't work with
content.partners.exclusions.lead: Our drivers are aged 16 and over. That is why we do not work with companies from these sectors:
content.partners.exclusions.skins: Skins, cases and loot boxes involving real money
content.partners.exclusions.crypto: Cryptocurrencies, NFTs and similar investment products

content.stream.title: Stream
content.stream.description: The league's races live on Twitch – with a two-click player, so no data goes to Twitch until you click.
content.stream.lead: Our race-day live stream runs here. The player only loads when you want it to.
content.stream.consent.title: Load the stream?
content.stream.consent.text: The player is provided by Twitch (Twitch Interactive, Inc., USA). Your browser only connects to Twitch once you click “Load stream”. Among other things, your IP address and information about your device are then transmitted, and Twitch may set cookies.
content.stream.status.offline: Offline right now – you'll find the next race date in the calendar.
content.stream.none.title: No stream planned at the moment
content.stream.none.text: As soon as we stream our races, you will find the player here – and a LIVE notice will appear in the menu at the top.
content.stream.vod.title: Missed it? The recordings
content.stream.vod.text: Twitch deletes recordings after a while. That is why we archive our races on YouTube and link them on each race page.
